naturalControl.qualityObservation: After the v3.2 prompt fix, the natural bubbles no longer show English command summaries: each scenario starts with a Chinese task-level sentence. The read steps still fall back to filenames because read has no description field and the model did not write a public sentence before those calls; no natural post-result sentence was available, so the natural control does not itself prove result-continuation (the guided control does). The task-scope constraint in the natural prompts is a normal task constraint, not progress guidance.
